title: padding-box vs border-box
description: background 的每一層都能指定畫到哪裡停：底色只畫到 padding-box、邊框漸層畫滿 border-box，透明邊框就會露出漸層，這是漸層邊框按鈕的標準寫法。頁面把三種 box 的邊界畫出來，並列出寫錯的三種情況；邊框寬度和底色那層的 box 可以直接調。
descriptionEn: Every background layer can stop at a different box: the fill stops at padding-box while the border gradient fills border-box, so a transparent border reveals the gradient — the standard way to build gradient-border buttons. The page draws all three box edges and lists three common mistakes; the border width and the fill layer's box are adjustable.
author: Antonio
